Name: Paritee's Gender-Neutral Farm Animals
Author: paritee
Description:
[b]Why?[/b]

This is complementary mod to my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296]Better Farm Animal Variety[/url]﻿ mod which lets you extend the farm animal types to things like bulls, roosters, etc. Unfortunately, the game data doesn't have a field for gender on the save files and hard-codes most of them (ex. uses the ID for pigs). If you use the BFAV mod, this removes the feminized text and icons for such interactions.


[b]Install[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Unzip the folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
